issue.title: Duplicate entries after adding
issue.body:
### What happened?

Tapped add twice quickly, got two copies.

### App version

2.3.0 (ios)

### Report

```tribrach-report
{"model": "todo.v1", "start": [], "ops": [{"op": "add", "id": 1}, {"op": "add", "id": 1}], "observed": [{"id": 1, "done": false}, {"id": 1, "done": false}], "privacy": ["operation-names", "item-ids"]}
```
